  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organization" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Decide</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_1" name="Vacation request needed" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Submit" name="Submit vacation request" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Decide" name="Approve or reject the request" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Approved" name="Request approved?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review" name="Review the rejection reasons" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Complete" name="Complete the management procedures" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Done" name="Vacation managed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Approved" targetRef="Task_Review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Approved" targetRef="Task_Complete" />
